A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we derive the pdf and cdf of the mutual information for MIMO systems with spatially correlated keyhole channels.

the mutual information statistics of MIMO keyhole channels are characterized by a pdf with a single peak, a cdf that is a strictly increasing function of the SNR, and a mean value that is monotonically increasing in the SNR.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the mutual information statistics of a MIMO system in keyhole channels can be characterized by the same expressions as for a single-input single-output (SISO) channel with the effective channel power gain replaced by a weighted sum of the individual channel power gains.

, for the considered MIMO keyhole channels, the mean mutual information is independent of the input correlation matrix and that it is a monotonously increasing function of the keyhole gain, i.e., of the channel capacity, which can be exploited for the design of efficient adaptive keyhole channel estimation schemes.

the mutual information of spatially correlated MIMO keyhole channels with colored noise exhibits the same asymptotic behavior at high SNR as the corresponding uncorrelated channel case, which is in stark contrast to the case of uncolored noise.
